d: Jet black hair is styled with straight bangs and two long braids draped over the shoulders, framing a youthful face with a neutral, mature expression and deep brown, almond-shaped eyes. The slender build is dressed in a military-style outfit consisting of a pale olive-green short-sleeved blouse with a dark brown neckerchief and a matching dark olive-green pleated skirt. The ensemble is completed with white-striped black stockings and heavy grey metallic ship weaponry rigged to the back.
